cmd_0:
You were born into poverty in a small village and swept into military service during the last general levy thirty years ago. Ingenuity and grit lifted you through the ranks to command Naku Keep, guarding the northern road to Bemm. You have always striven to balance justice with discipline, wisdom with courage. Your Orthopraxy is not the zealous fundamentalism of the north, but quiet personal right-doing.

In your years at Naku Keep you have fended off countless raids from the Sultanate of Dinn, but now the drums of war beat louder than ever. The Moot has recalled you to the general levy once again, this time as its commander. The Free State is tired of living in the shadow of cupidinous empires. It falls to you to blunt the new Sultan’s thrust into Boonan lands and claim for your people a place in history.
cmd_1:
What frustrates a great leader more than to reap the consequences of others’ failures? For twenty years you have held the reins of this kingdom, and still it bucks and chafes at the bit. Your father was weak, as was his mother, and all your ancestors back to foolish Pophanes who failed to exterminate the Allakian barbarians when he had the chance.

You will make no such mistakes. The decline of Delisgar ends with you. By the Thousand Saints have you sworn it; in the shrines and in the Hagiomphalos have you sworn it: your sword will drink blood until the last knee bends or breaks.
cmd_2:
You grew up among the rough and hardy folk of Allakia. Though you bear a Delisgrene name, you scoff at the degeneracy of the imperial line. At the helm of a reaver galley, you earned the respect of your people, and you consider yourself Allakian in every way that matters.

News of the Diamond Isle’s fall to the Sultanate of Dinn has whipped your people into a frenzy. If Delisgar cannot defend the shrines of the saints themselves, what right does it have to rule Allakia? Your cousin Sofonisba has had her chance, and she has failed. Perhaps it is time a stronger leader claimed the throne.
cmd_3:
Rulership has always come easily to you. While lesser men debate and complain, you act decisively and win. Your honored father, peace be upon him, prepared you well for the throne, and you do your best to honor his memory. When the viziers complained that the treasury was running dry, you sent ships to sack the Diamond Isle and loot its mines. When the Delisgrene ambassador insulted you to your face, you ordered him beheaded. Simple solutions that your inferiors seem unable to see. 

Now your eyes turn south, toward the city of Bemm. They speak Dinn there; why shouldn’t they welcome your rule? You’ve always wanted to command an army. Doubtless you’ll excel in that, as you do in all things.
